member.name: T:LeadSoft.Adapter.Azure.EntraID.IAzureSSO
member.summary: Defines methods for performing Azure Single Sign-On (SSO) operations, including group membership management and user authentication, using OAuth and Azure Entra ID.
member.remarks: Implementations of this interface provide asynchronous operations for integrating with Azure SSO scenarios, such as adding users to groups and retrieving user profiles. All methods are asynchronous and may require appropriate Azure permissions. The interface inherits from IDisposable, indicating that implementations may hold resources that should be released when no longer needed.

member.name: M:LeadSoft.Adapter.Azure.EntraID.IAzureSSO.AddGroupMembersAsync(System.String[])
member.summary: Asynchronously adds one or more members to the group using their email addresses.
member.param: An array of email addresses representing the users to add as group members. Each email address must be a valid, non-empty string.
member.returns: A task that represents the asynchronous operation. The task result is if all members were successfully added; otherwise, .

member.name: M:LeadSoft.Adapter.Azure.EntraID.IAzureSSO.GetOAuthSSOAsync(System.String,System.Boolean,System.Boolean)
member.summary: Initiates an OAuth single sign-on (SSO) authentication process using the specified user code.
member.param: The user code received from the OAuth provider to initiate the SSO authentication. Cannot be null or empty.
true to force a new authentication session even if a valid session exists; otherwise, false.
true to include the user's profile picture in the response if available; otherwise, false.
member.returns: A task that represents the asynchronous operation. The task result contains a DTOAzureEntraIDSSOResponse object with the authentication result and user information.

member.name: M:LeadSoft.Adapter.Azure.EntraID.IAzureSSO.GetUserProfileAsync(System.String)
member.summary: Asynchronously retrieves the user profile associated with the specified email address.
member.param: The email address of the user whose profile is to be retrieved. Cannot be null or empty.
member.returns: A task that represents the asynchronous operation. The task result contains a DTOAzureEntraIDUserProfileResponse object with the user's profile information.

member.name: M:LeadSoft.Adapter.Azure.EntraID.IAzureSSO.GetEnvironmentAsync
member.summary: Asynchronously retrieves the current environment name or identifier.
member.returns: A task that represents the asynchronous operation. The task result contains a string representing the current environment name or identifier.

member.name: T:LeadSoft.Adapter.Azure.EntraID.Register
member.summary: Provides extension methods for registering Azure single sign-on (SSO) services with an IServiceCollection for dependency injection.
member.remarks: Use the methods in this class to add Azure SSO functionality to an application's service collection. These methods enable consuming components to receive an IAzureSSO implementation via dependency injection. Call the appropriate method during application startup to configure the desired service lifetime.

member.name: M:LeadSoft.Adapter.Azure.EntraID.Register.AddSingletonAzureSSO(Microsoft.Extensions.DependencyInjection.IServiceCollection)
member.summary: Adds a singleton implementation of the IAzureSSO service to the specified IServiceCollection.
member.remarks: Call this method during application startup to register Azure single sign-on services for dependency injection. This enables consuming components to receive an IAzureSSO instance via constructor injection.
member.param: The IServiceCollection to which the IAzureSSO singleton service will be added.

member.name: M:LeadSoft.Adapter.Azure.EntraID.Register.AddScopedAzureSSO(Microsoft.Extensions.DependencyInjection.IServiceCollection)
member.summary: Adds the Azure single sign-on (SSO) service to the specified service collection with a scoped lifetime.
member.remarks: This extension method registers the IAzureSSO implementation for dependency injection, enabling Azure SSO functionality throughout the application's scope.
member.param: The service collection to which the Azure SSO service will be added. Cannot be null.
